title: KAITO — What Style Would Be Good?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, our set list seems fine...!
So, let's start discussing effects and such for our show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can we have it snow?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Snow? Yeah, that'd be a nice way to make things feel more wintery.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It should go very well with this set list too since we've included an assortment of winter-themed songs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! But how do we actually do that? It's not like we can make it really snow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The confetti should work.
Oh, if we want to make it seem more real, we can try using some dry ice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a great idea! It should make for a spectacular scene!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let me just jot that down... Confetti... Dry ice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for always taking notes for us, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to thank me. It's sort of become a habit, likely because I'm also a manager.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, let's move on to other suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I have one♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we wear costumes that go with the theme of our show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, our costumes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's a good idea, but not many of our costumes have a winter feel to them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's one with a broach that looks like a snowflake, and another that's really white and poofy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That probably won't be enough.
So, I was hoping we could do something about that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, we could try making some alterations to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I agree. I kinda want to try doing that too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: However, that means we won't be able to use them like we did before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not a problem! We can try making them modular.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Modular? Like having detachable parts?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. For example, we could add some fur around the neck and lace trim with a snowflake pattern to the skirt.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By doing that, you'd be able to enjoy both the original and the altered version.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We don't have to limit ourselves to just winter either. This approach should let us make costumes for a wide variety of themes♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. At the very least, we should be able to prepare costumes that go with the theme of our next show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start coming up with some ideas for alterations?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what do we actually need to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well... First, it might be good to inspect the base costume you'll be altering.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, consider which song you'll be wearing it for. That should help you come up with alteration ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Let's try that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it's like when the girls came up with the designs for their outfits!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and now it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup. And it looked like a lot of fun while they discussed their designs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
Oh, what if I attached some wings? I could be like a snow fairy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like a wonderful idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start picking out our costumes.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They all seem very excited about this. I might get left behind if I'm not careful.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (So, I'll try coming up with ideas for alterations that will really make them shine when they're on stage!)
